reviews.body: The leather grain has incredible depth without any artificial sheen. The heavy silver YKK zippers glide smoothly and the diamond-quilted shoulders give it a commanding silhouette. Fits true to size.
reviews.staffReply: Thank you, Rahul! Every Obsidian hide is grain-matched and tailored by our senior master cutter.

reviews.productTitle: High-Waisted Black Leather A-Line Midi Skirt
reviews.title: The panel seams and walking slit are cut to perfection
reviews.body: Finding real full-grain leather skirts in India with proper breathability used to be impossible. The silk cupro lining keeps it light, and the front slit makes walking up stairs completely effortless.
reviews.staffReply: So glad you love the drape, Pooja! We designed the high-rise waistband specifically for all-day comfort.
